## Session Brief

* [G-HY2: hygiene review of the diagnoses PR (#89)](G-HY2.md) - Review G-V1's bounded tau draw and G-V4's Breit-Wigner tau map, the NoUsableWeight refusal and the small-width deviation concept, for maintainability, test non-vacuity, visibility and reusable abstractions; write findings before editing; fix with mutation evidence.
* [G-V1: why card 048 integrates to one nonzero point with μF = 0](G-V1.md) - Diagnose CMS card 048 (XtoYYprimeTo4Q, p p > vz, vz > h z): why one point per seed carries σ at the gridpack card, why the defaults' seeds disagree, why μF logs 0 and '0 resonant pairs'; fix or refuse each defect with a test.
* [G-V2: why VEGAS under-covers a 3 % slice, and making the stop see it](G-V2.md) - Locate the per-channel floor or allocation that leaves the both-W |cos θ| > 0.99 slice of u u~ > w+ b w- b~ / t t~ 3 % low at the default budget, and make the convergence stop detect it, or propose a runtime warning to the user.
* [G-V3: attribute the two macOS heap-corruption aborts](G-V3.md) - Narrow the two one-off libmalloc aborts to a cause: an unsafe audit of the dependency tree, Miri on the suspect pure-Rust paths, clang AddressSanitizer covering zstd-sys and the other C code, a soak, and an exact M3 soak request.
* [G-V4: a Breit–Wigner τ map for a whole-state s-channel resonance; generate's panic; the small-width deviation](G-V4.md) - A hadronic process whose s-channel resonance carries the whole final state gets a Breit–Wigner τ map (p p > h z through a 1 MeV Vz, gated over ≥5 seeds against MadEvent); generate's 'no channel produced a usable weight' panic becomes a named refusal; MadEvent's small-width convention is registered as a deviation.

## Session Report

* [G-V1 report: card 048's one nonzero point is a τ draw the whole-state decay window did not bound; μF = 0 is only the print](G-V1-report.md) - CMS card 048 (p p > vz, vz > h z at MVz = 3500, WVz = 1 MeV) integrated to one nonzero point per seed because the hadronic τ draw ran from the forced window's lower edge to τ = 1, so the ±52.5 MeV window was 2.2e-5 of the unit interval. Bounding τ from above by the window (artifact format 18) gives 184092 ± 63 pb at the gridpack's PDF against MadGraph's survey 1.811e5 ± 779, and 185426 ± 62 pb against a fresh MadEvent 1.828e5 ± 123 at nn23lo1; the residual 1.5% is MadGraph's small-width treatment, predicted at 1.0155 and measured at 1.0144 ± 0.0008. The per-event scale is √ŝ on both sides; μF = 0 is the summary line only.
* [G-V2 report: the 3 % slice deficit is gone on main, and a point-level tail index is the indicator that sees it](G-V2-report.md) - On main the both-W |cos θ| > 0.99 slice integrates correctly at the default budget (30 seeds, -0.07 % and +0.07 %, chi2/dof about 1, against a 1e6 reference and a frozen-grid estimator). The deficit reproduces on the V2-era tree (-2.4 %, 10 seeds); its cause was a heavy weight tail from timelike-only channels that the unbounded grid adaptation starved, with the convergence stop stopping on the iterations that missed the tail. The bin-width bound and the peripheral spine removed it. An iteration-scatter indicator is blind to exactly the low runs; a per-channel Hill tail index below 2 flags 16 of 17 at-risk runs and 0 of 330 correct ones. No production code: a runtime-warning proposal (decision G5).
* [G-V3 report: neither macOS heap-corruption abort is attributable to code that Linux tools can see](G-V3-report.md) - No corrupting write was found. Every C and asm path in the two crashing processes runs outside the crash window or deterministically, and ASan, valgrind, Miri and TSan are clean on them; mimalloc is not linked; the workspace has no unsafe outside unchecked-study. What remains is the macOS side (the nano allocator or the host), so the M3 soak with and without the nano zone stays the closing measurement. glibc's MALLOC_CHECK_ needs libc_malloc_debug.so preloaded.
* [G-V4 report: a Breit–Wigner τ mixture for a narrow whole-state resonance; generate's panic named; the small-width deviation registered](G-V4-report.md) - p p > h z through a 1 MeV Vz at 3.5 TeV scattered by 17% over five seeds under the log τ map (in-run χ²/dof up to 52). A Breit–Wigner component per whole-state pole, mixed with the log map at the channels' shares, gives 185698 ± 23 pb over 25 seeds (χ²/dof 0.78) against MadEvent's 185757 ± 9 (five seeds): 3.2e-4 low, inside the 1.2e-3 bound MadEvent's small-width treatment sets without a window. The rule switches only on a peak under 1e-3 of the log map's unit interval, so every banked row and card 048's chain keep their maps bit for bit. generate's scan panic is the named refusal NoUsableWeight.
